questions.question_text: $\triangle KLM$ has been translated to give $\triangle RST$. Are the triangles congruent?

options.text: Yes, because a translation preserves shape and size
No, because the triangles are in different positions
options.why: This treats position as part of congruence; a translation changes position while preserving shape and size.

options.text: No, because a translation changes side lengths
options.why: This confuses a translation with resizing; a translation leaves every side length unchanged.

questions.solution_text:
A translation keeps the same shape and size.
The triangles are congruent.
